WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, record_count,
         record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat, record_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();
